implementation_contract.worktree_requirement: Root assigns a unique independent worktree and owner based on the pinned integrated source; no edits to the current main worktree while combined checks run.
implementation_contract.reason: The existing S4 Goal tests use a synthetic protocol fixture and do not connect the real CLI Goal handling to the integrated S2 service and SQLite. The existing cliSessionBindingFixture already provides real api.HandlerWithClientRuntime and explicit BLOCKED admission without LIVE runtime; extending via a test-only adapter can test this connection without production changes.
implementation_bounds: Only apps/cli/cli_stream_test.go may change. No production code, API schema, migrations, dependency locks, canonical state, existing evidence or fixture labels are edited.

Reuse cliSessionBindingFixture with a separate test wrapper/adapter defined in this file for ResolveGoalBinding. Prefer embedding the existing fixture rather than adding behavior globally to it; preserve AdmitTurn returning RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with the explicit no-LIVE-runtime message.

Use actual API handler, domain service, temporary SQLite database, issued temporary test credential and project/workspace fixture. Any binding resolver adapter is labeled as a fixture and proves neither real runtime model-route discovery nor LIVE provider capability.

Call the actual CLI Goal flow and real HTTP command path. Do not fabricate Goal/Task/Run objects, successful goal.start responses, admission success, provider replies or cancellation confirmation. Read actual SQLite canonical rows and actual typed HTTP results for assertions.

Keep existing synthetic fixture tests and descriptions unchanged. New tests must distinctly label real-local-protocol-with-binding-fixture coverage. No external model/provider requests, stored user credentials or protected holdout access.

required_cases.case: Project-level goal.start carries null session/revision/epoch; actual typed result adopts its true session with snapshot revision/writer epoch. Database confirms one Goal/Requirement association and zero Task, Run, effect intent/effect execution or runtime dispatch attributable to the draft. CLI reports draft establishment only.

Actual non-draft request creates exactly one canonical Goal and its unique Task. Fixture AdmitTurn blocks because no LIVE runtime exists; CLI returns non-success (expected3), preserves the actual Goal/session, and does not claim execution settlement or independent acceptance. Database confirms no manufactured Run/effect.

Existing-session CLI refreshes through real session.get. Exercise stale revision/writer epoch at the actual protocol boundary and verify typed rejection with unchanged Goal/Task counts. An identical original command-envelope replay must return the original identity/result without a second Goal; a changed request with the same command ID must reject. Repeating unchanged intent with a new command ID must not create another Goal. Do not incorrectly expect identical idempotent replay itself to reject.

required_evidence: New test names with actual raw per-test JSONL, actual integer process exit and input/source hashes captured in a new owner evidence directory.
Current source suite regression includes existing apps/cli S1/S4 tests; the new test file does not replace their evidence or erase failed history.
Independent source review against the exact registered test-only path before Root integrates this test commit.

limits: Test-only; do not change production runtime, schema, thresholds, shared metadata or original fixtures globally.
Wrap existing cliSessionBindingFixture with narrowly scoped ResolveGoalBinding for these explicit fixture tests only.
Real local API/domain/SQLite Goal draft+blocked protocol proof; not external provider or formal acceptance.
Exact same envelope replays original identity; changed payload same key/stale CAS/writer refuse with zero new Goal.
lease_rationale: Earlier CLI owner work is integrated; original owner is not a live agent in this continuation. One test owner in isolated worktree, Root alone integrates.
